fusions.name: Canopy Drop
fusions.desc: Drops you onto a target up to 6 tiles away, then the falling axe deals 16 damage and leaves it 15% easier to wound for 7 seconds.

fusions.name: Hobbling Toss
fusions.desc: Throws the axe at a target up to 6 tiles away that deals 7 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach, and slows the target by 40% for 4 seconds. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Whetstone Hour
fusions.desc: After a 2-second pause to whet the edge, increases your damage by 35% for 20 seconds.

fusions.name: Stump Sitter
fusions.desc: Each time you kill an enemy, you recover 3 stamina a second for 5 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
